subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the experimental core `claws add` lifecycle and land this stateful mutation slice before the prerequisite/read-only and follow-on owner slices are accepted as a supported stack?
rationale: This is a new core CLI and persisted-state contract rather than a repair to an established behavior; implementation review cannot determine whether RFC 27 should become an OpenClaw-owned product surface or in what merge order.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
options.body: Confirm RFC 27 ownership and require exact-head recovery and upgrade proof before reviewing the full stack in dependency order.

options.title: Keep the work external or experimental-only
options.body: Decline landing the core lifecycle now and direct future work toward an external package or a narrower approved seam.

options.title: Request a narrower proposal
options.body: Ask for a limited read-only or generic core seam first, leaving durable mutation and provenance ownership for a separately sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
recommendation.body: Confirm RFC 27 ownership and require exact-head recovery and upgrade proof before reviewing the full stack in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly associates this person with the RFC-stacked discussion; this is a low-confidence routing signal rather than a claim of code ownership.
